segments.name: Media
segments.description: Owns and operates Spanish-language television and radio stations and digital marketing services, selling advertising to advertisers targeting U.S. Latino audiences.
segments.evidence: Our media segment consists of sales of advertising through various media, including television, radio and digital.

segments.name: Advertising Technology & Services
segments.description: Provides programmatic advertising solutions globally to advertisers, primarily mobile app developers, through its platform and performance marketing agency brands.
segments.evidence: Our ATS business empowers advertisers, primarily mobile app developers, to grow their businesses globally.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers pay the company for advertising across broadcast and digital media, and mobile app developers pay for programmatic advertising and performance marketing solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: We serve our advertisers by providing marketing capabilities across broadcast and digital media.

changes.text: In 2024 the company discontinued and divested a significant portion of its operations that comprised most of its former digital segment.
changes.evidence: In 2024, we discontinued and divested a significant portion of our operations, which consisted primarily of several acquisitions that had been completed prior to 2024, and which operations comprised the majority of our former digital segment.

changes.text: In 2024 the company sold its Entravision Global Partners business.
changes.evidence: during the second quarter of 2024 we sold our Entravision Global Partners, or EGP, business.

changes.text: In 2024 the company realigned its operating segments into two segments, media and advertising technology & services.
changes.evidence: Effective July 1, 2024, we realigned our operating segments into two segments – media and advertising technology & services, or ATS – consistent with our current operational and management structure.
